entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: A Gateless Gruul-born young woman, insignificant by birth magic, who narrates the battle and guards her friends; she loses Hekara's recognition.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A shield mage who can see Rat and uses his shields as a battering ram in the battle.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker and Orzhov guildmaster, a ghost-assassin who swears the Gatewatch Oath and is hired to assassinate Liliana Vess.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: A resurrected Rakdos blood witch who fights bravely but no longer remembers or sees Rat.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker and Izzet guildmaster who agrees to hunt Tezzeret.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker and Golgari queen who reunites with Jace and is assigned to hunt Dovin Baan.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and Gatewatch planeswalker who reconciles with Vraska and is replaced as Living Guildpact by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Gatewatch planeswalker who wields Blackblade against Nicol Bolas, fails, and dies transferring his life to Liliana Vess.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and Gatewatch planeswalker sent to reactivate the Immortal Sun, who later burns the Eternals' remains.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A Gatewatch planeswalker who creates bubbles of slowed time.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin Gatewatch planeswalker who insists on renewing Oaths.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker elf who swears the Gatewatch Oath and wraps Gideon's armor in leaves.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who helps burn the remaining Dreadhorde.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem planeswalker who crushes Eternals.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A thief planeswalker who magnetizes the Eternals' lazotep and is killed when an Eternal harvests his Spark.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A planeswalker from Amonkhet who beheads Eternals and asks for dignity for her people.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A dragon-linked planeswalker who returned from Amonkhet with the spear of Hazoret.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who controls the Eternals for Bolas, then turns on him and is saved by Gideon.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker who is dismantled when Bontu harvests the Sparks he had absorbed.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The resurrected Izzet dragon and new Living Guildpact who stabs Bolas with the Spear of Hazoret.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon parun and guildmaster of the Cult of Rakdos who flies Gideon to the Citadel and takes Hekara away afterward.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A God-Eternal archer who shoots Gideon's pegasus and is obliterated by Bolas.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A God-Eternal who bites Bolas and harvests all his Sparks, exploding in the process.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: An Amonkhet God whose spear is used against Bolas.

entities.name: Boruvo
entities.description: Rat's centaur godfather who fights in the battle.

entities.name: Ari Shokta
entities.description: Rat's Gruul warrior mother who lends her an axe.

entities.name: Gan Shokta
entities.description: Rat's father who fights in the battle.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: A cyclops Gruul leader who fights with two maces.

entities.name: Vorel
entities.description: A Simic former Gruul clan leader who fights with a biomantic mace.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: The Azorius leader who commands Arresters and helps relay the guilds' judgment.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The Boros guildmaster who carries Gideon's breastplate.

entities.name: Tomik Vrona
entities.description: Kaya's Orzhov assistant.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: The Dimir shapeshifter guildmaster, who here disguises himself as Rai.

entities.name: Dame Exava
entities.description: A Rakdos blood witch present at the guild meeting.

entities.name: Bilagru
entities.description: An Orzhov giant who fights beside Kaya.

entities.name: Jiang Yanggu
entities.description: A planeswalker who leaves Ravnica with his dog.

entities.name: Mu Yanling
entities.description: A planeswalker who leaves Ravnica.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: The stone corpse of the Azorius sphinx guildmaster, behind which the Gatewatch confer.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who aided Bolas; Zarek agrees to hunt him.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A planeswalker who aided Bolas; Vraska is assigned to hunt him.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon planeswalker whom Karn suggests hunting.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: The sphinx whose Spark reinforces the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Maladola
entities.description: A Boros angel fighting in the sky.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers who renew their Oaths and accept Kaya.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Bolas's army of undead Eternals controlled by Liliana.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The Rakdos guild whose guildmaster joins the battle.

entities.description: The guild whose airship Parhelion II joins the attack.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Izzet guild whose mages join the battle.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The Simic guild represented by Vorel.

entities.description: The Azorius guild whose Arresters fight.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The Dimir assassins fight alongside others.

entities.description: The guild led by Kaya.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The guild ruled by Vraska.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The wild clans of Ravnica.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The Selesnya guild whose equenauts join the air force.

entities.description: Gideon's sword that shatters against Bolas's brow.

entities.name: Beacon
entities.description: Izzet device shut down earlier.

entities.description: The portal shut down earlier.

entities.name: Parhelion II
entities.description: The Boros airship that joins the sky attack.

entities.name: Bolas's gem
entities.description: The mystic gem floating between Bolas's horns, collecting stolen Sparks; it drops when he dissolves.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where the final battle occurs.

entities.description: Bolas's pyramid where the final confrontation takes place.

entities.description: Where the second summit of planeswalkers takes place.

entities.description: The plaza before the Citadel.

entities.description: The floating city housing the Immortal Sun.

entities.description: The ruined Gatewatch clubhouse and site of the earlier ritual.

events.summary: Gideon addresses the second summit at the Azorius Senate House and lays out a two-pronged attack to finish Bolas with Blackblade.
events.quote: Then I'll stab Bolas with Blackblade. And it will all be over.

events.summary: The Gatewatch renews its Oaths, and Nissa speaks hers for the first time.
events.quote: Never again. Not on any world.

events.summary: Gideon and Jace ask Chandra to return to New Prahv and reactivate the Immortal Sun to stop Bolas bolting.
events.quote: We want you to return to New Prahv and turn the Immortal Sun back on.

events.summary: Dack Fayden overhears and backs the plan, and Chandra sets off with Rai, Nissa and guildmembers.
events.quote: They set off for New Prahv.

events.summary: Vraska and Jace reunite and agree to try a relationship after Bolas is dead or they are.
events.quote: So tomorrow we give it a try . . . after Bolas is dead or we are?

events.summary: Guild forces and planeswalkers charge the Citadel as the Dreadhorde engages them.
events.quote: Those Planeswalkers not fallen—or not yet fallen—were side by side with guild warriors, engaging the silent Dreadhorde.

events.summary: An Eternal harvests Dack Fayden's Spark once the Sun is reactivated, killing him.
events.quote: As Dack's Spark was ripped from him

events.summary: Rat protects Teyo, Kaya and Hekara during the fight.
events.quote: So I focused on protecting those three.

events.summary: Boros airships and sky forces arrive and Gideon rides a pegasus toward Bolas.
events.quote: He was wielding the sword that could bring an end to all this—by bringing an end to Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Liliana and the God-Eternal Oketra shoot Gideon's pegasus, and he falls behind the Citadel.
events.quote: Instead its six-foot length impaled his mount.

events.summary: Rakdos appears as a giant flaming demon with Gideon riding his head, charging Bolas.
events.quote: And then I spotted Mister Jura, riding atop the demon's head.

events.summary: Bolas blasts Rakdos back, but Gideon leaps over and strikes; Blackblade shatters against Bolas's brow.
events.quote: Blackblade shattered against Nicol Bolas's invincible brow.

events.summary: Liliana turns the Eternals against Bolas, switching sides.
events.quote: I knew then that Miss Raven-Hair had switched sides.

events.summary: Liliana begins to disintegrate; Gideon heals her by taking her death into himself and is destroyed.
events.quote: In exchange, her black death was transferring over to him.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet stabs Bolas with the Spear of Hazoret but is thrown aside.
events.quote: Hovering behind him and holding the spear was Master Niv-Mizzet

events.summary: Oketra is destroyed, and Bontu bites Bolas and harvests all his Sparks, exploding.
events.quote: Bontu began harvesting all the Sparks the Elderspell had granted the dragon.

events.summary: Bolas disintegrates and dies, his gem dropping to the Citadel roof.
events.quote: I watched as Bolas began to dissolve

events.summary: Liliana picks up the gem and planeswalks away; others begin leaving.
events.quote: Then she stood up again and, in a cloud of black, planeswalked away.

events.summary: Chandra and Jaya burn the remaining Dreadhorde to ashes with dignity at Samut's request.
events.quote: meticulously burned every last one—every last fragment—down to ashes

events.summary: Hekara performs with puppets and cannot remember what Rat looks like; Rakdos carries her off.
events.quote: I can't quite remember what Rat looks like.

events.summary: Planeswalkers debate what to do with the Immortal Sun, and Ajani insists the Gatewatch renew its purpose.
events.quote: we need to confirm that the next time a threat rises, the Gatewatch will be there

events.summary: Kaya swears the Gatewatch Oath and is accepted.
events.quote: Never again. For the living and the dead, I will keep watch .

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet tells Jace the Firemind is the new Living Guildpact.
events.quote: The Firemind is the new Living Guildpact.

events.summary: Nissa and Chandra wrap Gideon's armor in leaves and the Gatewatch leads a solemn procession.
events.quote: wrapped Mister Jura's armor in the leaves

events.summary: The guilds assign Zarek to hunt Tezzeret, Vraska to hunt Dovin Baan, and hire Kaya to assassinate Liliana.
events.quote: And Kaya, the ten guilds wish to hire you to assassinate Liliana Vess.

relations.note: They agree to try a relationship after the battle.
relations.quote: So tomorrow we give it a try . . . after Bolas is dead or we are?
The Gatewatch, meanwhile, was making a bit of a show over the renewal of their Oaths.
Never again. For the living and the dead, I will keep watch .

relations.note: She controlled the Eternals for Bolas.
relations.quote: that necromancer still controlled those Eternals for Bolas

relations.note: She turns the Eternals on Bolas.
relations.quote: the Eternals had clearly turned on their master, at their mistress's command

relations.note: Oketra's arrow impales his pegasus mount.
relations.quote: Instead its six-foot length impaled his mount.

relations.note: Bontu harvests all of Bolas's Sparks, causing his death.
relations.quote: Bontu began harvesting all the Sparks the Elderspell had granted the dragon.

relations.note: They had been friends until recently.
relations.quote: Miss Vess and Mister Jura had been friends until very recently.

relations.note: Niv-Mizzet is the Izzet guildmaster and new Living Guildpact.
relations.quote: The Firemind is the new Living Guildpact.
Mistress Kaya raised an eyebrow at Mister Vrona, who nodded.
I figured my parents and godfather could pretty much take care of themselves.
cheered loudly for her unholy guildmaster
Lord Rakdos himself was descending to find his Emissary.
